payload.body: Provide `nahel decisions`, a deterministic read-only store-wide ledger of resolved map-ticket decisions. The compact default selects the newest 10 and renders that slice oldest to newest; users widen or narrow with --since, --by, --map, --provenance, and --limit, then zoom through concrete ticket, map, recall, and validate guidance. Rows show the decision, current human-readable title with stable IDs, exact resolver when provable, and only additive proof-backed badges: direct-human, delegated, ratified, agent, and incomplete. Never render cross-agent-grilled without a future typed proof marker. Incomplete rows remain visible and upgrade from current durable state after repair. This delta also requires the quoted-phrase usage hint for `nahel recall`.
